reason: The mechanism is real and the speech act is misread, which collapses the consequence. Driven in chromium at 1440 across all seven states with motion=settled: the footer does print BOUND WORKSPACE, OWNER, READING DATE AND THE 9 in every state, including empty, loading and error, and in empty and error no other 9 appears in main. But the stamp is not a reading of the current state - it is the lab's provenance disclosure. lately.html:903-904 sets the last two stamps as a pair, LAB counts and ages are lab-authored / BOUND workspace, owner, reading date and the 9, and fixture.js's generated header names exactly those four: 'Four facts are bound to src/lib/project-truth-fixture.ts and fail the build on drift: the reading date, the owner, the workspace name and the open-work denominator. Weekly completions, job ages and status counts are lab-authored.' The behaviour gate says the same thing in its own words at interaction-check.mjs:260-267, under the comment 'Provenance', asserting 'the surface says which of its numbers are lab-authored'. So the Bound stamp asserts 'the open-work denominator this lab is bound to is 9', a statement about the fixture binding that is true in all seven states, not 'you have 9 open jobs this morning'. Nothing untrue is asserted, so the honest-degradation contract - a missing source must not resolve to a fabricated number - is not touched: in empty and error the surface fabricates nothing in main, and the footer figure is the build-gated bound value, the opposite of a guess. The finding's own logic, applied evenly, would condemn its neighbour just as hard: LAB COUNTS AND AGES ARE LAB-AUTHORED also prints in empty and error where no count and no age is on screen. The seat does not raise it, because that stamp is plainly provenance - and so is the one beside it. Two load-bearing claims are also wrong when driven. (1) 'the denominator card is not on screen in any of those three states' - in loading it is on screen: VIEW.loading (lately.html:973-975) renders the real movementOne/movementTwo DOM inside .sk-wrap, so the denominator card sits there at its real geometry as the box the numeral will land in, ink taken out and aria-hidden. (2) The error copy quoted, 'Nothing below is shown, because a part of this screen would be guessing', is about the reading below that card; the provenance footer sits outside that scope and states what the harness is bound to, not what Tasks returned. Severity is overstated on top of that: misleading requires the product to assert something untrue, and this asserts something true about the artifact - refinement at most, and the awkwardness is a definite article in a lab-only strip that does not ship to Orla. The proposed fix is also the wrong move and would make the work worse. DENOM_STATES suppression makes the provenance line state-dependent, so in empty, loading and error the footer would claim only three figures are bound to src/lib/project-truth-fixture.ts. That is false - four are, and derive-fixture.mjs fails the build on drift of all four including openCount. It trades a slightly awkward reference for an actually untrue provenance claim in exactly the three states the finding says exist to say what is not known. A correct problem with a wrong fix is refuted; here the problem is not correct either.
sharpenedFix: Do not make provenance state-aware. If the definite article is worth removing at all - and it is cosmetic, not a contract breach - fix it once, identically in all seven states, by naming the figure instead of pointing at it: replace lately.html:904 with `Bound workspace, owner, reading date and open count (${D.open})`. That keeps the stamp true in every state, keeps all four bound facts named wherever the surface is read, holds the stamp voice short enough for tracked uppercase mono (the gate comment at interaction-check.mjs:263-266 records that a single sentence carrying both halves ran to 134 characters), and leaves /Bound/ and /reading date/ matching so the existing gate assertion still passes.
breaks: The finding's own fix would silently falsify the provenance disclosure in three states and would defeat the purpose of the LAB/BOUND pair, which exists so a reviewer can tell an authored number from a bound one wherever they land; it also introduces a fourth state list (DENOM_STATES) beside SOURCES that must be kept in step with F.scopes and with every future state, a drift source derive-fixture.mjs does not guard. If the sharpened wording is taken instead, re-measure: interaction-check.mjs:261-267 (the /lab-authored/, /Bound/ and /reading date/ coverage assertions still match, but re-run to confirm), audit.mjs for the label ramp and leading on .coverage, and the footer's wrap behaviour at 390 and 768 - .coverage is a flex-wrap row on --gap-hair/--gap-room, so a longer sixth stamp changes where the strip breaks and how tall the footer is in all seven states.
